Class JsonParser

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.JsonParser
public final class JsonParser extends Object

Parses RFC 8259 JSON strictly: a document that is not valid JSON, has an object with two members of the same name, or exceeds a limit, is rejected with a JsonParseException. Set to another JsonFormat, it parses JSONC or JSON5 as strictly.

JsonDocument document = new JsonParser().parse(bytes);
JsonParser strict = JsonParser.builder().maxDepth(64).unknownMembers(UnknownMembers.REJECT).build();

A document is validated whole before anything is read from it. Everything is parsed from UTF-8 bytes: a String is encoded first. A byte order mark is rejected.

A parser is immutable and thread-safe, and holds nothing but its settings: creating one per call costs nothing.

Since:
0.1.0

    • parseLines

      public Stream<JsonDocument> parseLines(byte[] input)

      Parses JSON Lines: one JSON value per line, each a document of its own.

      Lines end with \n, the last one optionally; the \r of a \r\n is whitespace. A blank line, or a value that does not end on its line, is an error, thrown when the stream reaches that line. The limits apply to each line, and positions are those in the whole input.

      Parameters:
      input - the lines, in UTF-8; it is not copied, and must not change while the documents are used
      Returns:
      the documents, one per line, parsed as the stream is consumed
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this parser reads JSONC or JSON5: JSON Lines are JSON only

    • parseLines

      public Stream<JsonDocument> parseLines(ByteSource source) throws IOException

      Parses JSON Lines, as parseLines(byte[]) does, read as the stream is consumed.

      The source stays open until the stream is closed: close it, with a try-with-resources statement. An error reading the source is an UncheckedIOException, thrown by the stream.

      Parameters:
      source - the lines, in UTF-8
      Returns:
      the documents, one per line, parsed as the stream is consumed
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this parser reads JSONC or JSON5: JSON Lines are JSON only
      IOException - if the source cannot be opened
